results.title: UC Out-of-State Acceptance Rates by Campus: Fall 2026 Data - Oriel Admissions
results.content:
TL;DR: UC out-of-state acceptance rates for fall 2026 ranged from 10.0% at UC Berkeley and 14.9% at UCLA to 37.2% at UC San Diego, 49.5% at UC Irvine, 63.9% at UC Santa Barbara, and 71.0% at UC Davis, based on preliminary University of California systemwide data as of June 17, 2026.
UC Davis admitted 71.0% of out-of-state applicants for fall 2026, the highest nonresident rate among selective UC campuses.
